description: `muster msg post --to almond` failed with "nobody here or on a machine linked to this one is called almond" while the pane existed; `--group almond+berry` then posted and said "not woken: almond (..., no agent in its pane)", exit 6. The --to error reads as a wrong name. Resolve a callsign whose pane has no agent and post as the group form does, or say that in the error. From tooling feedback a_2zsVPaYdd.
title: msg post --to says nobody is called X for a pane whose agent left
